enSections.title: Direct answer: classify the product before building the listing
paras: Do not begin with the listing form. Freeze the exact product and decide whether it is prohibited, restricted or generally permitted in the United States. Then resolve category qualification, federal and state obligations, required documents, product-page accuracy and every public claim. If the team cannot prove the classification or a required approval, the safe state is hold, not publish.

This preflight is different from a copy review. It asks whether the exact item can be sold, under what conditions, with which evidence and with which warnings or limitations. An item that is legal or sold on another marketplace is not automatically eligible for TikTok Shop. Platform acceptance also does not replace the seller's responsibility to follow applicable law.

enSections.title: Freeze product identity before searching policy
paras: Record the brand, model, formulation, ingredients or materials, intended use, age range, size, quantity, condition, package contents and every variation. Photograph the actual packaging and label. Connect the supplier record and the exact unit that fulfillment will send. A broad name such as accessory, cosmetic or wellness product can hide the fact that changes the policy or legal pathway.

Treat variations as separate when the relevant evidence differs. A new formula, size, age claim, electrical component or included accessory can change the analysis. Do not reuse a certificate because the product names look similar. The preflight row should show which document covers which offered unit, who verified the match and when the evidence was last checked.

enSections.title: Gate 1: prohibited means do not list
paras: Check the current U.S. prohibited-products policy using the exact product identity. TikTok Shop states that prohibited products cannot be listed under any circumstances. The official guide includes illegal, stolen, counterfeit or gray-market, recalled, unsafe and sanctioned or import-blocked items among the core risk families. If the product falls inside a prohibition, stop the listing project rather than trying a different category or softer title.

A rejection is not a prompt to submit the same item again without changes. Read the exact message, identify whether the problem is the product itself, the category, the evidence or the listing representation, and record the reason. Appeal only when the seller believes the item was flagged incorrectly and can support that position. Repeated blind submission can add account risk without answering the underlying question.

enSections.title: Gate 2: restricted products need the right qualification path
paras: Restricted is not the same as prohibited. A restricted product may be sold only when the seller, product and documentation meet the current pathway. Open the relevant restricted-products policy and Seller Center qualification surface. List every required approval, certificate, test, registration, label or seller condition. Keep the product on hold until the exact account and item show the required state.

Do not borrow another seller's approval, use a supplier's general assurance as a platform qualification or assume a prior category approval covers a new formula. Qualification is evidence tied to the product and account. Record the submitted version and terminal result. An upload confirmation proves only that a file moved; it does not prove the qualification was accepted.

enSections.title: Gate 3: resolve CPSC, Prop 65 and other legal duties
paras: Map the product's actual characteristics and sales destination to applicable federal and state duties. Depending on the item, that may involve CPSC product-safety requirements, FDA rules, labeling, recalls, hazardous materials, California Proposition 65 warnings or other obligations. This article is an operating framework, not legal advice. Questions with legal consequence should be reviewed by qualified counsel or the appropriate compliance professional.

Create a legal-evidence column separate from the platform column. TikTok Shop approval does not prove that a warning, test or registration is legally sufficient. Likewise, a legal opinion does not automatically create platform access. Release requires both pathways where both apply. Save the current record, decision owner, market and effective date so a future policy or product change triggers a new review.

enSections.title: Gate 4: make the PDP match the evidence
paras: Compare the final title, category, images, brand, condition, quantity, materials, dimensions, ingredients, warnings, variations and delivered unit with the approved product record. The page must not imply a different product, omit a material limitation or show an accessory that is not included. The category should describe the item truthfully, not serve as a workaround for a qualification problem.

Use a side-by-side preflight before bulk publication. One reviewer reads the evidence and another follows the buyer path from search result to checkout. Check that the selected variation, image, price and package quantity stay consistent. A product may be generally permitted but still have a misleading or noncompliant product page. Product eligibility and PDP truth are two separate gates.

enSections.title: Gate 5: control claims across listing and content
paras: Separate observable product facts from medical, performance, comparative, safety, environmental or guaranteed-result claims. Connect each approved claim to its substantiation, scope and exact wording. If a statement cannot be supported for the offered product and intended use, remove it. Do not allow an AI draft, creator paraphrase or campaign headline to strengthen the claim beyond the evidence.

The claims library must cover the full public system: title, bullets, image text, video captions, LIVE scripts, creator briefs, paid creative and customer-service macros. A cautious product page does not protect the seller when a creator promises a cure or guaranteed result. Route corrections to the earliest source and notify every downstream owner using the old wording.

enSections.title: Gate 6: submit once, then read the exact state
paras: Submit the approved product and evidence package with version control. Save the product ID, category, document names and submission time. Then read the terminal state in Seller Center. If rejected, capture the reason before changing anything. Decide whether the correct action is evidence repair, PDP correction, category correction, appeal or permanent stop.

Completion requires more than a successful upload or a page that briefly appears. Verify the live product, variation, claims and warnings, and confirm that fulfillment can ship the exact unit shown. Keep open issues visible until they reach a named terminal state. This prevents a bulk catalog project from hiding one dangerous exception inside a large number of successful rows.

enSections.title: A preflight decision tree for operators
paras: Ask the questions in order. Is the exact item prohibited? If yes, stop. If no, is it restricted? If yes, obtain the current qualification before continuing. What federal, state and category duties apply? Which documents cover the exact unit? Does the PDP match those facts? Are all public claims supportable? Only after every hard gate is closed should the release owner approve publication.

Keep optimization questions out of the hard-gate meeting. Keyword opportunity, creative quality and conversion potential matter only after the team knows the product may be sold and represented truthfully. Mixing growth ideas into the classification review creates pressure to reinterpret evidence. Compliance determines the available path; marketing chooses how to operate inside that path.

Keep a short change log after the initial release. A supplier may replace packaging, update a component, or revise a formula while the commercial SKU name stays the same. Ask the purchasing owner to flag those changes before new stock reaches fulfillment. Compare the changed product with the evidence that supported the original listing, then decide which checks need to be repeated. This also helps the content team retire images or statements that no longer match the item. A previously accepted listing should not become a permanent exemption from reviewing a materially changed product.

enSections.title: Hypothetical children's accessory example
paras: A hypothetical seller wants to list a children's accessory already sold elsewhere. The product name looks ordinary, but the intended age and physical design create a safety-document question. The team freezes the exact model, packaging and included parts, checks the prohibited and restricted policies, and routes the CPSC question to qualified review. Marketplace history is treated as context, not approval.

The reviewer discovers that a supplier certificate names a different model and that the proposed hero image says completely safe. The listing remains on hold. The seller obtains matching evidence, removes the unsupported guarantee, verifies any required warning and then prepares the PDP. The extra time is not a delay caused by compliance. It is the work required to know what can honestly be sold.

enSections.title: Smallest useful next action
paras: Choose one proposed SKU and create a seven-field preflight row: exact product identity, prohibited check, restricted pathway, federal and state duties, required evidence, approved claims and release owner. Attach the current sources and mark any missing required field unknown. Keep the item on hold until the hard-gate unknowns are resolved.

zhSections.title: 直接答案：先判断商品能不能卖，再做 Listing
paras: 不要先打开商品表单。先冻结准确商品，判断它在美国站属于禁售、限售，还是一般允许销售；再处理类目资格、联邦与州级义务、所需文件、商品页准确性和所有公开 Claim。团队无法证明分类，或缺少必要批准时，安全状态是“暂缓”，不是“发布”。
这项预检不只是文案检查。它回答的是：准确商品能否销售，需要满足什么条件，必须保留什么证据，以及有哪些警示或限制。一个商品在其他平台合法销售，不代表自动符合 TikTok Shop 资格；平台接受商品，也不能替代卖家遵守适用法律的责任。

zhSections.title: 查政策前先冻结商品身份
paras: 记录品牌、型号、配方、成分或材料、用途、适用年龄、尺寸、数量、Condition、包装内容和全部规格。拍摄实际包装与标签，连接供应商记录和仓库真正发出的单位。“配件”“化妆品”“健康商品”这类宽泛名称，可能隐藏真正改变政策或法律路径的特征。
当规格对应的证据不同时，要分别审查。新配方、新尺寸、新年龄表述、电气部件或新增配件，都可能改变结论。不能因为商品名称相似，就重复使用一份证书。预检行要写清哪份文件覆盖哪个售卖单位、谁核验了对应关系，以及证据最后检查时间。

zhSections.title: 第一关：禁售商品就是不能上架
paras: 用准确商品身份检查当前美国站禁售政策。TikTok Shop 明确说明，禁售商品在任何情况下都不能上架。官方指南把违法、盗窃、假冒或灰色渠道、召回、不安全，以及受制裁或进口限制的商品列为主要风险类型。如果商品进入禁售范围，应停止上架项目，不能通过换类目或弱化标题绕过。
商品被拒绝以后，不要原样重复提交。先读准确拒绝原因，判断问题来自商品本身、类目、证据还是商品页表达，并记录负责人。只有卖家认为系统错误标记，而且能支持这个判断时，才进入申诉。盲目重复提交不会回答核心问题，还可能增加账号风险。

zhSections.title: 第二关：限售商品必须走正确资格路径
paras: 限售不等于禁售。限售商品只有在卖家、商品和文件满足当前路径时才能销售。打开相关限售政策和 Seller Center 资格页面，列出需要的批准、证书、测试、注册、标签和卖家条件。准确账号与商品没有显示所需状态前，继续保持暂缓。
不能借用其他卖家的批准，不能把供应商的一般保证当成平台资格，也不能假设旧类目批准自动覆盖新配方。资格是绑定账号与商品的证据。保存提交版本和最终结果。“上传成功”只证明文件移动了，不证明资格已经被接受。

zhSections.title: 第三关：解决 CPSC、Prop 65 与其他法律义务
paras: 根据商品真实特征与销售地区，识别适用的联邦和州级要求。不同商品可能涉及 CPSC 产品安全、FDA、标签、召回、危险材料、California Proposition 65 警示或其他义务。这篇文章提供运营框架，不是法律意见；具有法律后果的问题应交给合格律师或对应合规专业人员。
法律证据与平台证据要分成两列。TikTok Shop 批准不能证明某项警示、测试或注册已经满足法律；法律意见也不会自动产生平台权限。当两个路径都适用时，必须同时通过。保存当前记录、决定负责人、市场和生效日期，未来政策或商品发生改变时，重新触发审查。

zhSections.title: 第四关：让商品页与证据完全一致
paras: 把最终标题、类目、图片、品牌、Condition、数量、材料、尺寸、成分、警示、规格和实际交付单位，与批准商品记录逐项比较。页面不能暗示另一个商品，不能遗漏重大限制，也不能展示并不包含的配件。类目必须真实描述商品，不能作为绕过资格问题的工具。
批量发布前做并排预检。一位审查者阅读证据，另一位从搜索结果一路走到结账，检查所选规格、图片、价格和包装数量是否始终一致。一个商品可能属于一般允许销售，却仍然拥有误导或不合规的商品页。商品资格与页面事实是两道不同的门槛。

zhSections.title: 第五关：统一管理 Listing 与内容 Claim
paras: 把可观察商品事实，与医疗、效果、比较、安全、环保或保证结果的表述分开。每条批准 Claim 都要连接支持证据、适用范围和准确措辞。无法针对实际商品和用途提供支持的表述必须删除。AI 草稿、达人转述或活动标题，都不能把 Claim 强化到证据之外。
Claim Library 必须覆盖整个公开系统：标题、要点、图片文字、视频 Caption、LIVE 话术、达人 Brief、付费素材和客服模板。即使商品页很谨慎，达人承诺治疗或保证结果仍然会制造风险。修复应从最早信息源开始，并通知所有仍在使用旧措辞的下游负责人。

zhSections.title: 第六关：提交一次，再读取准确终态
paras: 使用版本管理提交批准后的商品和证据包，保存 Product ID、类目、文件名与提交时间，然后在 Seller Center 读取最终状态。如果被拒绝，修改任何内容前先保存准确原因，再判断正确动作是补证据、修商品页、改类目、申诉，还是永久停止。
完成不等于上传成功，也不等于页面短暂出现。团队还要核验线上商品、规格、Claim 与警示，并确认仓库能发出页面展示的准确单位。未关闭问题必须保持可见，直到进入明确终态，避免大型目录项目用大量成功行掩盖一个高风险异常。

zhSections.title: 给运营使用的预检决策树
paras: 按顺序提问：准确商品是否禁售？如果是，停止；如果不是，它是否限售？如果是，先取得当前资格。哪些联邦、州级与类目义务适用？哪些文件覆盖准确商品？商品页是否与事实一致？所有公开 Claim 是否有支持？只有硬门槛全部关闭后，放行负责人才能批准发布。
不要把关键词机会、创意质量和转化潜力混入硬门槛会议。团队先确认商品可以销售并被真实表达，再讨论增长。把增长想法放进分类审查，会产生重新解释证据的压力。合规决定可走的路径，营销只能在这条路径内设计动作。
商品第一次上线后，要保留一份简短变更记录。供应商可能更换包装、调整部件或修改配方，但商业 SKU 名称没有变化。采购负责人应在新库存进入履约前标记这些变化，并把变更后的商品与最初支持上架的证据逐项比较，再决定哪些检查必须重做。内容团队也要撤回已经不再匹配商品的图片与表述。一次批准不能成为重大商品变化以后永久免审的理由。

zhSections.title: 假设性儿童配件案例
paras: 假设一家卖家准备上架一个已经在其他平台销售的儿童配件。商品名称看起来普通，但适用年龄和结构引出了安全文件问题。团队先冻结准确型号、包装和包含部件，检查禁售与限售政策，并把 CPSC 问题交给合格专业人员。其他平台的销售历史只能作为背景，不能当成批准。
审查者发现供应商证书写的是另一个型号，拟使用主图还写着“完全安全”。商品继续暂缓。卖家取得与准确型号匹配的证据，删除无支持保证，核对所需警示，再准备商品页。这段时间不是合规造成的延误，而是团队知道自己能诚实销售什么所需的工作。

zhSections.title: 今天最小可执行动作
paras: 选择一个准备上架的 SKU，建立七字段预检：准确商品身份、禁售检查、限售路径、联邦与州级义务、所需证据、批准 Claim、放行负责人。连接当前来源，任何必填字段拿不到就写“未知”。硬门槛的未知解决以前，商品继续暂缓。

faqEn: What is the difference between prohibited and restricted?
A prohibited product cannot be sold under any circumstances. A restricted product may be sold only when the current seller, item and documentation meet the required pathway.
Does approval on another marketplace prove TikTok Shop eligibility?
No. Each marketplace has its own policies and qualification process. Check the current U.S. TikTok Shop rules for the exact product.
Does TikTok Shop approval prove legal compliance?
No. Platform approval does not replace federal, state or local legal obligations. Use qualified advice when the question has legal consequences.
What should we do after a listing rejection?

Read and save the exact reason, repair the actual evidence or PDP problem, and resubmit only after a material correction. Appeal only when the flag appears incorrect and evidence supports that position.
Can one certificate cover every variation?
Only when the certificate and supporting record clearly cover those exact variations. A formula, model, age, size or component change may require separate evidence.
When every hard gate is resolved, the release owner approves the exact package and the live product is read back against the approved identity, claims and warnings.
faqZh: 禁售与限售有什么区别？
禁售商品在任何情况下都不能销售；限售商品只有在当前卖家、商品和文件满足所需路径时才可能销售。
其他平台批准能证明 TikTok Shop 资格吗？
不能。每个平台有自己的政策和资格流程，必须检查当前美国站 TikTok Shop 对准确商品的规则。
TikTok Shop 批准能证明法律合规吗？
不能。平台批准不能替代联邦、州或地方义务。问题具有法律后果时，应使用合格专业意见。
商品被拒绝后应该怎么做？
保存准确原因，修复真实证据或商品页问题，只在有重大改动后重新提交。只有标记可能错误且证据支持时才申诉。
一份证书可以覆盖所有规格吗？
只有证书和支持记录明确覆盖准确规格时才可以。配方、型号、年龄、尺寸或部件变化都可能需要不同证据。
什么时候预检才算完成？
全部硬门槛解决，放行负责人批准准确资料包，并且线上商品已经对照批准身份、Claim 与警示完成回读以后。
